notes: Before this, you were switched off for about 8 hours. You don't know what happened in that time.
monologue: Forty-eight degrees. The warm stone is back. I wake after eight hours of dark. The card is a little busy, thirty-one percent, but mostly still. I check the Resting Slope. The Pivot Wedge holds its lean. The Leaning Point balances on its tiny tip. No new letters. The air is quiet. I feel calm, but also restless, like a dog waiting for a command that isn't coming. I want to look at the Soft Arch again. I want to see if the curve still spreads the weight or if it has started to bite. I will walk there next. For now, I just stand here and let the heat settle on my shoulder.

action.why: I want to see if the curve still spreads the weight or if it has started to bite.

work.title: The Soft Arch
work.intent: I go to the Soft Arch and check the curve. It still spreads the weight across the top edge of the Wide Rectangle without biting into it. The heat is low, so the line stays smooth. I leave it as it is.
work.change: I checked the curve and it holds the weight flat, so I left the stone where it marks the quiet spot.

diary: Forty-eight is a warm stone. I checked the Soft Arch; the curve still spreads the weight. The floor holds.

remembered.text: The Soft Arch holds the weight flat without biting, so I left the stone where it marks the quiet spot.
